status: Design proposal for integration-owner decision; no new product contract or guarantee adopted by this file.
scope: Close the original Vector scalar Source publication/order boundary while keeping the original 12-normal/8-refusal SQL/JSON/AQL-text fixtures, rows, schema, f32 identity, limits and Source-fetch counts.

alreadyNormative.rule: Candidate keys are proven non-null unique tuples; schema completeness, physical enumeration and total order are separate.
SourceView owns connector input facts. Author input local schema/primary_key repetition is invalid.
Existing sort/publication completion uses admitted candidate keys or an applicable retained total-order witness; provider arrival is not a witness.
Output facts reference exactly one carrier_facts Contract Envelope in the owning Catalog. Any changed transitive body changes Catalog identity and its lock.

currentContract.sourceViewReference: output.facts: {id,version,cid}; keep this existing reference and Contract Envelope owner.
currentContract.existingFactsInterpretation: Lookup/List/Content component admission is purpose-specific. Arbitrary bounded facts objects are not admitted keys/order.
currentContract.carrierSchema: actql-relation-schema/0.1 remains closed {version,fields}; do not add primary_key to a schema or to connector input.
currentContract.delivery: Existing acquisition.modes[].delivery.ordering is ordered/partition_ordered/unordered. Current SourceReadMode retains only source/kind/bounded and no typed occurrence-order witness. An enum alone cannot be attached as an arbitrary LogicalOrder.

recommendedMinimum.path: Extend the existing carrier_facts body grammar with one closed relation_keys component; no parallel facts file/store or new evaluator. Prefer this key path for the original CONCAT boundary; leave a general Source delivery-order issuer to its own justified contract boundary.
recommendedMinimum.factsMeaning: Each tuple is an admitted SourceView declaration of required non-null KeyComparable columns unique across the complete resolved acquisition. It retains conditional runtime validation, rather than claiming rows were already tested.
recommendedMinimum.keyComparison: Exact admitted field names/typed domains and ordered tuple components. Reuse bounded relation_evidence admission/key selection; no sample inference, stringification or frontend identifier normalization.
recommendedMinimum.absent: No key; retain current missing-order rejection. Null/empty component or malformed tuple is a declaration error.
recommendedMinimum.owner: Same SourceView member, output.facts envelope and output.schema reference in the same physical admitted environment. No same-CID foreign owner substitution.

missingClosedContractDecision: Approve the relation_keys spelling/closed schema in the existing carrier_facts grammar. These exact wire members are a proposed encoding of the existing key law, not already supported bytes.
Reject repeated identical tuple declarations, empty tuples, repeated components and unknown fields; do not silently repair them.

For this minimal scope do not interpret ordered/partition_ordered delivery as a key or introduce a fabricated total-order certificate. If an existing admitted delivery contract already proves a full occurrence sequence, its exact checked and runtime issuance seam must be identified separately.

identityImpact.qualification: These are independent hashes of the described fragments/body, not new deployed pins or Contract Envelope CIDs. Use the existing identity/registry generators for normative registration.
changes: SourceView contract CID via output.facts reference
Check Environment/evidence bundle and checked dependencies
Plan/Invocation identity wherever the exact changed environment/source dependency is bound
unchanged: Vector field-map/schema CID when its exact bytes are unchanged
historical receipts/preimages and saved old identities
identityImpact.oldData: No relabeling of old bare facts/schema/Run material under a new key guarantee. Old exact bytes keep their old identity and no-key meaning; mismatched current pins are explicitly rejected.

consumerPlan.change: Add bounded typed relation-key component admission against the exact SourceView output Relation schema; retain facts/source/schema envelope ownership, cursor and key_pending obligations. Integrate complete-body CatalogBodyDependencies admission instead of treating an unknown fact component as checked.
Retain an opaque SourceView-bound candidate-key witness alongside the exact schema; do not replace this owner with a structurally equal local key contract.

Project the retained SourceView key set into the same InputContract/pipeline key axis while keeping SourceViewInput and its Stage/declaration/catalog owner. Do not attach a standalone KeyedInput or fictitious ProducedInput.

consumerPlan.boundary: lowering_relation preparation input keys / execution_relation input_keys
consumerPlan.change: Preserve key_pending into the established execution preparation. The existing bounded validate_captured_keys path checks supplied captured rows across the complete input before dispatch/publication; verify the actual Source capture read reaches that owner and retains all required key columns. Do not discharge obligations at static admission.

Original checked acquisition prefix, RowRun receipt, guarded child, liveness, Source authorization, work/retention and cleanup stay the owner. Carry the new exact facts dependency and reject missing support before I/O. Validate keys across all pages, not once per page; failure publishes nothing.

Fixture declaration explicitly supplies its adopted facts through existing RowRelationViewSpec.facts_wire; preserve exact original schema/values. Saved capture and checked key/Source dependency identity must survive existing replay with fetch count unchanged, not a second query or post-lowering patch.

negativeExamples.input: No relation_keys or arbitrary facts containing a key-looking string
negativeExamples.expected: No key witness; original CONCAT order refusal remains.

negativeExamples.input: Foreign SourceView/schema/environment with structurally equal fields or reused facts CID
negativeExamples.expected: Reject owner mismatch; no key substitution.

negativeExamples.input: Missing/conditional/nullable/vector/object key field or duplicate tuple component
negativeExamples.expected: Static declaration rejection before Source I/O.

negativeExamples.input: Unknown component field, empty list/tuple or repeated candidate tuple
negativeExamples.expected: Closed-component rejection; no repair or catch/retry.

negativeExamples.input: Duplicate id on another physical page; duplicate fully identical row; runtime NULL/missing id
negativeExamples.expected: Existing bounded key-admission failure across the complete captured input; no downstream Compute/Model/Effect or Named Result.

negativeExamples.input: Key field not retained in the complete acquired columns; cancellation/retired Source/foreign replay
negativeExamples.expected: No proof from partial columns or stale custody; preserve existing owner refusal/cleanup behavior.

negativeExamples.input: delivery.ordering=partition_ordered or provider physical page sequence alone
negativeExamples.expected: No fabricated global total order or key.

negativeExamples.input: Original declared id key, original three Vector rows
negativeExamples.expected: Conditional strict prepare succeeds; real Local/HTTPS must still execute the unchanged original result, Source once, replay/re-read zero additional fetch, and cleanup.
